properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): two edge findings from two projects on one day — `satisfies` rejects `coverage` although the stored SATISFIES edge carries it and the delivery roll reads it (bhome), and `constrains` materialises `basis: estimated` on an edge with no contribution (xrt-demo) — are one class: edge properties were never swept for reach or for asserting defaults, because the requirement that would have done it was DROPPED
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL on bhome ("satisfies cannot express partial coverage, but the edge property exists") and xrt-demo F6 ("constrains defaults basis to estimated even when no contribution is passed"), 2026-09-16.

① OBSERVED: bhome — `satisfies` rejected `coverage`; a later snapshot showed the stored edge carrying coverage: full, and graph_report's delivery line reads it; one capability that only partly satisfies its requirement is recorded as fully satisfying. xrt-demo — nine CONSTRAINS edges drawn deliberately without contributions all came back basis: estimated, "asserting the basis of a number that isn't there". Expected: coverage settable where it is read; basis absent when the number is absent. NOT affected: node-property defaults swept in July (Requirement.priority etc.).

② PRECEDENT: req:edge-defaults-do-not-assert — measured, precise, and dropped; req:defaults-do-not-assert (nodes) accepted and acted on; req:declared-vocabulary-is-reachable-from-the-surface, whose instrument (vocabulary_reach) reads node properties against toolsnaps.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the edge sweep was dropped, so edge defaults and edge reach were never checked; (b) vocabulary_reach only measures node properties, so an edge property read by a report and unreachable by its tool never shows as a HOLE; (c) constrains' handler passes basis through set_opt and the store applies the schema default on absence — a mechanism, not a decision; (d) the observation is wrong — coverage was never meant to be settable. ④ ⑤ MEASURED: (a) status dropped, read; (b) vocabulary_reach's docstring: "Every declared node property and edge property, from schema/*.yaml" — it DOES enumerate edge properties, so (b) is partly refuted: the hole should appear in its output; whether SATISFIES.coverage is listed as a candidate was not checked this session and is the open measurement; (c) confirmed in budget.rs — no logic ties basis to contribution; (d) refuted — report.rs reads coverage for delivery.

⑥ CLASS: the July node sweep's own rule, applied to edges, and never carried through because the requirement that stated it was dropped. Would fixing the class have stopped both reports? Yes: an edge-reach check would have named SATISFIES.coverage; an edge-default check would have named CONSTRAINS.basis. ⑦ PIN: satisfies with coverage: partial stores it and the delivery roll reads partial; constrains with no contribution stores no basis. ⑧ FIX AT THE CAUSE (his word): reopen req:edge-defaults-do-not-assert or record why it was dropped beside a narrower replacement; add `coverage` to satisfies; make constrains leave basis unset when contribution is absent (or refuse basis without contribution); run vocabulary_reach's edge half and read its HOLE list. ⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: why the requirement was dropped — the record says dropped and nothing says by whom or for what.
